title: Horizon
excerpt: Anti-overstimulation dashboard for global monitoring with AI that transforms information chaos into actionable insights

data.text: Horizon is a dashboard designed to transform global information chaos into actionable insights. Through 8 validated APIs (76 data points, 100% success rate), it monitors economy, crypto, news, weather and geopolitics providing only the information that matters. Anti-overstimulation philosophy: filters noise (only score >0.7), amplifies signals, reduces cognitive latency (max 8-12 insights per session).

Hybrid cloud + local AI: Gemini 2.5 Flash for classification, relevance scoring (0.0-1.0), urgency classification, sentiment analysis, topic clustering. Stack: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL (backend), Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Zustand (frontend). Sources: Alpha Vantage, CoinGecko, Finnhub, NewsAPI, OpenWeatherMap and more. Operational cost ~$54/month.
